D5/S3/QuantumBounds/GramRealizability.gr.name: D5.S3.QuantumBounds.GramRealizability.gram_realizability
D5/S3/QuantumBounds/GramRealizability.gr.signature: theorem gram_realizability {V : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℂ V] [CompleteSpace V] (Q : V →L[ℂ] V) : 0 ≤ Q ↔ ∃ O : V →L[ℂ] V, Q = O.adjoint ∘L O ∧ ∀ x y : V, inner ℂ (Q x) y = inner ℂ (O x) (O y)
